title: AI Works While You Sleep? OpenAI Dots Has a Catch #shorts
description:
Could an AI agent continue working on a report while you sleep? OpenAI's dots are always-on personal agents with a cloud computer and approved connected apps. This video uses a FICTIONAL illustration of a source-backed morning report; it is NOT footage of a tested dot or evidence that any real project was completed overnight. Grant only the permissions a task needs. Sensitive actions may still require approval.

Would you trust an overnight draft? YES or NOT YET?
Official announcement: https://openai.com/index/introducing-dots/
Availability and controls: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001530-getting-started-with-your-dot
Safety and approval limits: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001529-dots-privacy-security-and-safety-faqs
